scope: Native checks compile the complete provider and validate the unchanged disabled original prepared replay and expert permutation against original arithmetic, input immutability and guards. The new observer arithmetic is checked on the host against the actual original production combine; actual all40-layer GPU activation and production output comparison require the separate real-model pair. Native build and component success are not model inference evidence.

policy.selected_endpoint_interval_source: Original empirical PPB Cauchy envelope plus both neighboring BF16 endpoints; tiny, nonfinite or wider-than-nine-endpoint intervals receive no certificate.
policy.certificate_consumer: Original VT4 eight-route sum, routed BF16 endpoint, gated shared BF16 endpoint, combined BF16 endpoint and complete unrounded F32 residual.
